name: fairy crafts
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fairy crafts is a folkloric motif. Most fairies led easy and careless lives spent in dancing and feasting. Yet some of them held a trade. The leprechaun, the most familiar Irish fairy, served as shoe craftsman to the fairy world. He was a solitary fairy who kept the dancing ranks furnished with footwear. Fairy women were called fine spinners and weavers. They scorned the weaving skill shown by human women.

okr.objective: Fairy crafts is a motif of fairies who did useful work beyond dancing.
